title: The Trade-Offs of Letting Local Managers Make Hiring Decisions
authors: Hugh Xiaolong Wu; Shannon X. Liu
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiment with one common start date, and no data. Store.dta: post = 1 after the experiment begins (code restricts post-period cross-sections to daily_date > 30 Aug 2018), treatment = store randomly assigned to local-manager hiring. Table 6 col 2 (reghdfe lnsales did post treatment, absorb(storeid month#year)) is a common-date 2x2 DiD; Table 7 splits/interacts with store characteristics (subgroup-by-treatment interactions); satisfaction tables use store FE only; individual-level tables are cross-sectional.
design_notes: 12-month RCT across 111 retail stores of a Chinese chain; store-month sales panel plus cross-sectional new-hire and survey data.
estimators_reported: RCT cross-sectional OLS with region and month FE
common-date 2x2 DiD with store and month FE
n_adoption_cohorts_note: All treated stores start LMH at the experiment start (Sept 2018 per code date filter).
data_files_note: Readme.pdf: 'The data are not included in the replication folder due to data confidentiality and the data agreement with the partner firm.' Code-only package with result CSVs and a master log.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Common-start RCT; no data.
